(2) The man gestures with his right hand, pointing and waving as he interacts with an off-camera crowd. He then reaches down and pulls up a large purple box decorated with food images and Chinese brand logos, showing it to the viewer. (3) The scene shifts to high-definition close-up shots of various prepared dishes on a table: a dark soup in a white pot, a glazed pork hock, a bowl of shrimp curry, and steamed rice with mushrooms. Red captions with gold borders appear at the top describing the dishes. (4) Back to the man on stage, he holds the product box with both hands, smiling and nodding while speaking. A large blue arrow graphic appears at the bottom of the screen pointing to the right. (5) A static graphic covers the whole screen showing the full food set, price tags of 3980, and ordering details against a red and orange festive background.
